lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in three primary horizontal tiers of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; the medial row contains the most defined centroids, exhibiting approximately 10 discrete nodes with regular inter-blob spacing before clarity diminishes posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible rectangular grid-like lattice primarily in the anterior and mid-flank regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of specular highlights on the upper ridge and a dark shadow mask immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs located within the anterior and dorsal edges of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) visible as distinct elongated silhouettes attached to and trailing near the ventral-pectoral region.
